doc.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Live recording for Von Freeman's 75th birthday
summary: He plays regularly with his father and recorded a live celebration at the Blue Note with Dianne Reeves.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And how about, I see you have a new thing with your father here?

Well as I said we play together. We’ve been playing together for years. And this was his 75th birthday, which we celebrated here in New York at the Blue Note and we had Dianne Reeves as a guest with us. And we recorded there live and that’s what this record is, a celebration of his 75th birthday. So he and I are together on there along with Dianne Reeves.
